strategy.primary: Accelerate and protect a three-mana commander and attack with Nathan every turn. Each attack exiles the top card of every library and lets you cast one of them; trigger multipliers and extra combats (Roaming Throne, Firebender Ascension, Karlach, Fire Lord Azula) turn that into a repeatable heist.
strategy.secondary: A theft suite (Gonti, Thief of Sanity, Tinybones, Hostage Taker, Opposition Agent, Notion Thief, Laughing Jasper Flint) turns stolen resources into card advantage; payoffs like Don Andres and Nalfeshnee monetize casting cards you don't own.

commander_oracle_snapshots.name: Nathan Drake, Treasure Hunter
commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
First strike
You may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast spells you don't own or to activate abilities of permanents you control but don't own.
Whenever Nathan Drake attacks, exile the top card of each player's library. You may cast a spell from among those cards.
